title: Enigma Literacy Test (Demo)
introText:
You will take two assessments to help us figure out which Enigma game is the best fit for you, based on your reading skills.

There are no grades. Just do your best! Your answers will help us match you with a game that’s fun, challenging, and right for where you are as a reader.

tests.paragraph:
For the first test, you will hear a word, a sentence with the word, and the word again.
Type the word you hear. Do your best even if you are not sure how to spell it.
Tap the “speaker” if you need to hear the word again.
Press Start when you’re ready.

Great job! You finished the test.
Press Continue to start the next one.

Next, you will read a passage.
As you read, you will see word choices. Choose the word that makes sense in each sentence.

Press Continue to try an example.

tests.title: Practice Passage
tests.paragraph: Tom goes to school far from his house.  Every morning, he takes a % to go to school.  In the %, he also takes a bus home.

You will have 3 minutes to read the passage silently.
Choose the words that make sense in the sentences. Keep going until time is up.

Press Start when you’re ready.
